scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Hello? I'm Artisan Tene, the most respectful blacksmith of them all.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
你好？我是工匠泰内，最受人尊敬的铁匠。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
How may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: Which blacksmith?
scripts.translation: 哪位铁匠？

scripts.text: I want to add option.
scripts.translation: 我想添加选项

scripts.text: I want to remove option.
scripts.translation: 我想移除选项

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Oh! Sorry, I didn't introduce myself.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
啊！抱歉，我还没自我介绍。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
I can add or remove options from some weapons and armor at a small price.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
我可以以低廉的价格为部分武器和防具添加或移除选项。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Oh! Do you want to know the list of weapons and armor I work on?
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
啊！您想知道我能处理的武器和防具列表吗？

scripts.text: Take a look at the weapon list.
scripts.translation: 查看武器列表

scripts.text: Take a look at the armor list.
scripts.translation: 查看防具列表

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Are you interested in the weapon list?
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
您对武器列表感兴趣吗？

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
The weapons I work on are 
^ff0000Raksasa Dagger [1]^000000
^ff0000Mikatsuki[1]^000000
^ff0000Huuma Swirling Petal [2]^000000
^ff0000Huuma Fluttering Snow^000000
^ff0000Huuma Thunderstorm^000000
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
我能处理的武器是
^ff0000罗钗短剑 [1]^000000
^ff0000三日月[1]^000000
^ff0000风魔手里剑乱华 [2]^000000
^ff0000风魔手里剑乱雪^000000
^ff0000风魔手里剑雷雨^000000

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Are you interested in the armor list?
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
您对防具列表感兴趣吗？

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
The armor I work on is
^ff0000Wolf Armguard [1]^000000
^ff0000Crescent Armguard [1]^000000
^ff0000Ninja Scale Armor [1]^000000
^ff0000Tenebris Latitantes [1]^000000
^ff0000Special Ninja Suit [1]^000000

[Artisan Tene]
This is it. I'm still in practice to learn and handle more battlegear.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
就是这些了。我还在练习，以便学习并处理更多的战斗装备。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
If you'd like, I can add options to your 4th and 3rd Slots at a small cost.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
如果您愿意，我可以以低廉的费用为您装备的第4和第3槽位添加选项。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Oh! You need to add an option.
I use the method of adding options to your 4th and 3rd slots of battlegear equipped.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
啊！您需要添加选项。
我使用的方法是为已装备的战斗装备的第4和第3槽位添加选项。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Since I use a stable and unique way of adding options, there are no risks of ^ff0000'Reset Refine'^000000 or ^ff0000'Losing Cards'^000000 equipped.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
由于我使用稳定且独特的方式添加选项，因此不存在^ff0000'重置强化'^000000或^ff0000'丢失卡片'^000000的风险。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
But since the costs of materials are high, I only ask for a ^5565AA small cost^000000 for my services with the exception of the material expenses.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
但由于材料成本较高，除了材料费用外，我只收取^5565AA少量费用^000000作为我的服务费。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Ha ha. I must have talked too much. Which class of equipment do you want to add an option to?
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
哈哈。我可能说得太多了。您想为哪类装备添加选项？

scripts.text: Weapon...
scripts.translation: 武器...

scripts.text: Armor...
scripts.translation: 防具...

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
So you want to add an option to your weapon. That will be ^ff0000100,000 Zeny for a 1 time service.^000000
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
您想为武器添加选项。单次服务费用为^ff0000100,000 Zeny。^000000

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
^FF0000Ah! I can add an additional option if you equip a one-handed weapon on your right hand because it is easier for me to work on.^000000
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
^FF0000啊！如果您在右手装备单手武器，我可以额外添加一个选项，因为这样我操作起来更方便。^000000

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Which weapon do you want to add an option to?
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
您想为哪件武器添加选项？

scripts.text: Later...
scripts.translation: 稍后...

scripts.text: Raksasa Dagger [1]
scripts.translation: 罗钗短剑 [1]

scripts.text: Mikatsuki [1]
scripts.translation: 三日月 [1]

scripts.text: Huuma Swirling Petal [2]
scripts.translation: 风魔手里剑乱华 [2]

scripts.text: Huuma Fluttering Snow
scripts.translation: 风魔手里剑乱雪

scripts.text: Huuma Thunderstorm
scripts.translation: 风魔手里剑雷雨

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Changed your mind? Very well. Hope to see you later.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
改变主意了？好吧。期待下次光临。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
So you want to add an option to your armor. That will be ^ff0000100,000 Zeny for a 1 time service.^000000
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
您想为防具添加选项。单次服务费用为^ff0000100,000 Zeny。^000000

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Which armor do you want to add an option to?
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
您想为哪件防具添加选项？

scripts.text: Later...
scripts.translation: 稍后...

scripts.text: Wolf Armguard [1]
scripts.translation: 狼纹护手 [1]

scripts.text: Crescent Armguard [1]
scripts.translation: 月纹护手 [1]

scripts.text: Ninja Scale Armor [1]
scripts.translation: 忍者鳞甲 [1]

scripts.text: Tenebris Latitantes [1]
scripts.translation: 雾中暗影 [1]

scripts.text: Special Ninja Suit [1]
scripts.translation: 特攻忍装 [1]

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Changed your mind? Very well. Hope to see you later.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
改变主意了？好吧。期待下次光临。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
You want to remove an option from your item. You didn't like the option?
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
您想移除物品上的选项。是不喜欢这个选项吗？

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Sorry but I'm not experienced enough. You've paid me for nothing.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
抱歉，我的经验还不够。让您白花钱了。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
^ff0000Removing an option will be 100,000 Zeny.^000000 Which option from the list of items do you want to remove?
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
^ff0000移除选项的费用是100,000 Zeny。^000000您想移除列表中的哪个选项？

scripts.text: Later...
scripts.translation: 稍后...

scripts.text: Raksasa Dagger [1]
scripts.translation: 罗钗短剑 [1]

scripts.text: Mikatsuki [1]
scripts.translation: 三日月 [1]

scripts.text: Huuma Swirling Petal [2]
scripts.translation: 风魔手里剑乱华 [2]

scripts.text: Huuma Fluttering Snow
scripts.translation: 风魔手里剑乱雪

scripts.text: Huuma Thunderstorm
scripts.translation: 风魔手里剑雷雨

scripts.text: Wolf Armguard [1]
scripts.translation: 狼纹护手 [1]

scripts.text: Crescent Armguard [1]
scripts.translation: 月纹护手 [1]

scripts.text: Ninja Scale Armor [1]
scripts.translation: 忍者鳞甲 [1]

scripts.text: Tenebris Latitantes [1]
scripts.translation: 雾中暗影 [1]

scripts.text: Special Ninja Suit [1]
scripts.translation: 特攻忍装 [1]

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Removing options is expensive, isn't it? Sorry. I will work harder in developing my skills and bring down costs as well.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
移除选项的费用很高，对吧？抱歉。我会努力提升技术，并降低费用的。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
You want to reset ^44B7BC{0}^000000?
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
您想要重置 ^44B7BC{0}^000000 吗？

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
The cost is the same but I do provide a service to remove only the option on the 3rd slot and leave the 4th slot as is. Are you interested?
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
费用是一样的，但我提供只移除第3个槽位选项、保留第4个槽位的服务。您有兴趣吗？

scripts.text: Reset only the 3rd Slot.
scripts.translation: 只重置第3个槽位

scripts.text: Reset all.
scripts.translation: 全部重置

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Very well. I will reset only your 3rd slot.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
好的。我将只重置您的第3个槽位。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Very well. I will reset all slots.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
好的。我将重置所有槽位。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
You will have to equip all items before ^44B7BC{0}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
您必须在 ^44B7BC{0}^000000 之前装备好所有物品。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
I'm sorry, but you don't have enough Zeny!
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
很抱歉，您的Zeny不足！

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Our charge is very low, so please bear with me.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
我们的收费很低，请多包涵。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
I don't think this is the equipment you requested.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
我认为这不是您要求的装备。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
I cannot work on equipment other than those from my list.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
我无法处理列表之外的装备。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
The third slot is is not enchanted. Please check again.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
第3个槽位没有附魔。请再检查一下。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
This equipment is is not enchanted. Please check again.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
这件装备没有附魔。请再检查一下。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Initialization complete.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
初始化完成。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
This equipment cannot be further enchanted.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
这件装备无法继续附魔。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
If you are not satisfied with the enchantments, I suggest that you initialize.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
如果您对附魔结果不满意，我建议进行初始化。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
The fourth slot has already been enchanted. Shall I enchant the third slot as well?
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
第4个槽位已经附魔了。我要把第3个槽位也附魔吗？

scripts.text: Do it later
scripts.translation: 稍后再做

scripts.text: Do it now
scripts.translation: 现在做

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Very well. Hope to see you later.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
好的。期待下次为您服务。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Starting to enchant the third slot.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
开始对第3个槽位进行附魔。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
This equipment is not currently enchanted. Shall I enchant the fourth slot?
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
这件装备目前还没有附魔。我要对第4个槽位进行附魔吗？

scripts.text: Do it later
scripts.translation: 稍后再做

scripts.text: Do it now
scripts.translation: 现在做

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Very well. Hope to see you later.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
好的。期待下次为您服务。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
Starting to enchant the fourth slot.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
开始对第4个槽位进行附魔。

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
An unknown error has occurred. Please contact customer service. *^_^*
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
发生未知错误。请联系客服。 *^_^*

scripts.text:
[Artisan Tene]
^44B7BC{0}^000000
The equipment has been enchanted.
scripts.translation:
[工匠 泰内]
^44B7BC{0}^000000
装备附魔完成。
